facts.business: Mount Housing and Infrastructure Limited is engaged in real estate activities including housing and infrastructure development.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions entered into during FY 2025-26 were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. No contracts or arrangements were entered into that were outside the ordinary course of business or not on an arm's length basis. Transactions were placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval/review and before the Board where required. Interested directors disclosed their interest and abstained from participation in discussions and voting on relevant transactions. Particulars are disclosed in the Notes to the Financial Statements and in Form AOC-2 (Annexure I).
